Follower: Okay. Where is the Start?
Giver: It's marked with a cross, just north of the camera shop.
Follower: Okay, I see the camera shop down here.
Giver: Good. So we start there, then we head left and up a bit.
Follower: Left and up?
Giver: Yeah, away from the camera shop. Do you see the parked van?
Follower: Ah, there's a van over there.
Giver: That's the one. We pass it on the left, so turn right towards the bottom of the map.
Follower: Okay, turning right.
Giver: Then go down past the allotments. Are those the allotments there?
Follower: Yes, I see the allotments.
Giver: Good. We pass them on the right side of the path. Keep going down.
Follower: Okay, going down.
Giver: Then turn left, heading towards the bottom left corner almost.
Follower: Left?
Giver: Yeah, almost all the way to the edge.
Follower: Okay, turning left.
Giver: Then turn right again, heading up towards the top left.
Follower: Up towards the top left?
Giver: Yeah. We pass the disused monastery on the left as we go up. Do you see the monastery?
Follower: Oh, I see the monastery. But wait, I don't see the alpine garden near it.
Giver: Oh? Where is the alpine garden on your map?
Follower: It's way up near the top left, pretty far north.
Giver: Ah, okay. On my map it's lower down, near the monastery. So you might get confused there. We pass it on the right.
Follower: Oh, okay. So the monastery is on the left, and the garden is on the right.
Giver: Yes. Then we turn left again.
Follower: Left?
Giver: Yeah, heading down towards the bottom left again.
Follower: Okay, going down.
Giver: Then turn right, heading towards the middle right of the map.
Follower: Towards the middle right?
Giver: Yeah. We pass the youth hostel on the right as we go. Do you see the hostel?
Follower: I see the hostel, but it's quite far up.
Giver: Ah, okay. It's further up on your map. Just keep going towards the right.
Follower: Okay.
Giver: Then turn left again, heading towards the right side.
Follower: Left?
Giver: Yeah. We pass the telephone box on the left. Do you see the telephone box?
Follower: I see the telephone box. It's actually quite close to the middle right.
Giver: Ah, okay. So it's lower down on your map. Keep going towards the right.
Follower: Okay, going right.
Giver: Then turn left again, heading towards the top right.
Follower: Left?
Giver: Yeah. We pass the thatched mud hut on the right. Do you see the hut?
Follower: I see the hut. It's pretty far east.
Giver: Okay. Then turn left again, heading towards the top right corner.
Follower: Left?
Giver: Yeah. We pass the east lake on the right. Do you see the lake?
Follower: I see the lake. It's quite far north.
Giver: Ah, okay. It's further north on your map. Keep going towards the right.
Follower: Okay, going right.
Giver: Then turn left again, heading towards the bottom right.
Follower: Left?
Giver: Yeah. We pass the yacht club on the right. Do you see the yacht club?
Follower: I see the yacht club. It's quite far south.
Giver: Ah, okay. It's further south on your map. Keep going towards the right.
Follower: Okay, going right.
Giver: Then turn left again, heading towards the bottom.
Follower: Left?
Giver: Yeah. We pass the parked van on the left. Wait, did we pass that van before?
Follower: Oh! The van! There's a van near the bottom left too.
Giver: Ah, that's a different van. This one is near the bottom.
Follower: Okay, okay. Going down.
Giver: Then turn right again, heading towards the top right.
Follower: Right?
Giver: Yeah. We're heading towards the Finish now.
Follower: Okay, going right.
Giver: The Finish is marked with a cross. It's near the top middle.
Follower: I see the cross. It's near the top middle.
Giver: Good. Do you think you've got it?
Follower: I think so. I've drawn it from the start to the finish.
Giver: Okay. I'll check my map and see if it matches.
Follower: Okay.
Giver: Great.
Follower: Okay.
